name: رصيد
domain: resale of mobile airtime / top-up credit in Sudan
users: one airtime seller on one phone, offline, often one-handed, in Arabic
job: Record each credit sale in a few taps so stock, customer debts and the month's totals stay true, and hand over a PDF report or a full backup when needed

features.does: Total sales, total owed by customers and remaining stock per product
Sell credit: product, amount, optional customer, cash / Bankak / pay later
Browse and filter sales by product and payment, delete a sale
Add, edit, delete (only when nothing is owed) and view customers with purchased credit types, sales, payments and balance
Search customers, products, sales, payments and the stock log by name, phone, amount, method, note or date
Record a later payment against a customer with its own date
Add or remove products, set month opening stock, add or deduct stock with a reason, see the log
Monthly and date-range reports on screen, exported as Arabic RTL PDF to share or print
Export all data to one file, import with validation, switch language

entities.name: Product
entities.fields: id text stable, name text, sortOrder int, archived bool (soft delete), createdAt date

entities.name: Customer
entities.fields: id text, name text, phone text?, createdAt date

entities.name: Sale
entities.fields: id text, productId ref Product, productName text snapshot, amount money, customerId ref Customer?, createdAt date, method enum CASH|BANKAK|CREDIT

entities.name: Payment
entities.fields: id text, customerId ref Customer, amount money, paidAt date, method enum CASH|BANKAK, note text?

entities.name: StockEntry
entities.fields: id text, productId ref Product, kind enum OPENING|ADD|DEDUCT, amount money, reason text, createdAt date

design.thesis: Civic: white, a trustworthy deep green, one amber for notices; plain Arabic words, large touch targets, nothing decorative

gaps.needs: Bankak has no integration here; Bankak is only a payment label the seller records by hand
Injaz Cloud is not available to android apps; backup file is the way to move data
The PDF uses the phone's own Arabic font; a .ttf can be added to res/font

decisions: Platform is native Android (Kotlin, Compose, Room), not React Native: the project cannot be converted
Sale amount is the credit value sold and reduces stock 1:1; amounts are whole Sudanese pounds
Customer optional for cash and Bankak, required for pay later
A payment settles the customer's oldest credit sales first

A customer who owes money cannot be deleted; deleting removes only the customer, past sales and payments stay (shown as deleted customer) so stock, totals and reports do not change; backups accept records of deleted customers
Opening stock is dated at the start of its month and replaces that month's earlier opening
Import replaces all data inside one transaction after validation and confirmation
Digits are Latin (1,500); language switch Arabic/English in settings; Arabic is RTL
